_doc: Catálogo de sprites del juego (GDD §10). Cada asset se genera en ComfyUI con SDXL + pixel-art-xl y se posprocesa con comfy_pipeline.js. 'size' es el tamaño final en píxeles; 'transparent' indica si se quita el fondo. Cambiar el 'seed' da otra variante.

style.positive: pixel art, 16-bit game asset, crisp clean pixels, limited color palette, bold shapes
style.negative: blurry, photo, realistic, 3d render, text, letters, watermark, signature, frame, border, multiple objects, cropped, noisy, jpeg artifacts
style.object_suffix: single object only, large and centered, simple bold shapes, isolated on plain white background
style.tile_suffix: close-up natural texture filling the entire image edge to edge, large chunky pixels, flat front view, seamless tile
style.object_negative: shadow, drop shadow, multiple objects, collection, pattern, repeated, scene, background details
style.tile_negative: brick wall, bricks, masonry, planks, grid, object, character, sky
